record.what_it_does: Cloud data warehouse/platform for SQL analytics, data engineering, and AI workloads.
record.auth_notes: SQL API supports OAuth (Snowflake OAuth or External OAuth), key-pair JWT, and workload identity federation. OAuth is the choice for multi-user agents, using a security integration created in each customer's account. Programmatic access tokens also exist (not verified here).
record.access_notes: 30-day free trial needs only an email. AI features stay disabled until a credit card is added. Continued use needs a paid, consumption-billed account. There is no permanent free tier. Each customer account hosts its own OAuth security integration, so there is no central app review.
record.api_breadth_notes: The SQL API runs arbitrary SQL. The Snowflake REST APIs cover databases, schemas, tables, warehouses, users, roles, grants, stages, tasks, services, Cortex and more.
record.mcp_notes: Snowflake-managed MCP server, endpoint https://<account_url>/api/v2/databases/{database}/schemas/{schema}/mcp-servers/{name}. It uses OAuth and is documented under Cortex Agents MCP.
record.blocker_notes: Every account has its own hostname, so the toolkit must collect the account identifier per user. OAuth needs an admin to create a security integration. The trial lasts 30 days, then a paid account is needed. Webhooks are not offered. Event-like triggers would need polling, or Snowflake alerts and notification integrations.

evidence.quote: The trial continues for 30 days (from the sign-up date)
no payment information or other qualifying information is required.
These REST APIs are compliant with the OpenAPI specification.
The Snowflake-managed MCP server lets AI agents securely retrieve data from Snowflake accounts.

record.needs_human: Webhook absence is unverified. Confirm whether the trial's AI-feature credit-card restriction affects the toolkit's testing. The docs page I fetched for MCP is Cortex Agents MCP and may have moved.
